name: Michigan
summary: Statutes: legislature.mi.gov serves one PDF per MCL section at a constructible URL (documents/mcl/pdf/MCL-{chapter}-{section}.pdf) with a 'Complete Through PA N of YYYY' line; WebFetch reads them but built URLs are permission-gated, and the shell is refused (robots.txt answered with a bot check). Justia (2025) is a constructible tier-2 fallback. Constitution: the whole-text PDF mcl-chap1.pdf truncates in WebFetch at Art. IV. Court rules: courts.michigan.gov publishes MCR chapters as HTML pages and MRE / MRPC as PDFs; WebFetch reads them, but robots.txt disallows everything to the shell. Admin Code: ARS (ars.apps.lara.state.mi.us) serves rule-set PDFs by GET and works from the shell; Cornell LII mirrors per rule. Case law: courts.michigan.gov opinion and order PDFs (slip) plus free Michigan Appeals Reports bound-volume PDFs with official pagination; Justia covers Supreme Court and Court of Appeals published/unpublished opinions and orders by docket number.

law_aliases.MSA: MSA (Michigan Statutes Annotated, superseded numbering: convert to MCL via the MCL tables, no free route)

citation_map.notes: MCL numbers are chapter.section (600.5805 = chapter 600, section 5805); the chapter is the leading digits before the dot, so the per-section PDF URL is fully determined: MCL-{chapter}-{section with letters upper-cased}.pdf. Michigan's own style (Michigan Appellate Opinion Manual) drops periods: 'MCL 600.5805', 'MCR 2.116(C)(10)', 'MRE 702', 'Const 1963, art 1, § 17', '285 Mich App 1; 776 NW2d 314 (2009)', 'lv den 505 Mich 1023'. Bluebook: Mich. Comp. Laws § 600.5805; Mich. Ct. R. 2.116; Mich. R. Evid. 702. A range 'MCL 600.5801-600.5869' is a span: the regex captures the first section only. Old 'MSA 27A.5805' (Michigan Statutes Annotated) numbering is not routed. Bare 'R 408.10011' and bare 'Docket No. 359401' are generic and need Michigan context (context_required). 'Const 1963' alone is used only by Michigan in practice, but 'Mich' is preferred. No public-domain citation: Michigan cites to Mich / Mich App (official, West-published) and NW2d/NW3d; unpublished COA opinions are cited by docket number and issue date (MCR 7.215(C)). CourtListener ids mich / michctapp are from memory and unverified. 'MRPC' is also Minnesota's abbreviation, so bare 'MRPC 1.7' is not routed by a Michigan pattern (Minnesota's record owns it); with Michigan context, read it from mi-rules-mrpc. 'Act N of YYYY' collides with Pennsylvania's form and is not routed; use 'YYYY PA N'.

sources.publisher: Michigan Legislative Council / Legislative Service Bureau
sources.official_status_evidence: MCL Search page (https://legislature.mi.gov/Laws/MCLSearch) says the information 'is not intended to replace official versions of that information.' PDFs carry only 'Courtesy of legislature.mi.gov'.
sources.coverage: Every MCL section (including repealed-section notices) and every act as a separate PDF; chapter 1 = Constitution of 1963.

access.pattern_rules: chapter = digits before the dot, section = digits after it, with any letter suffix UPPER-cased (MCL 257.203a → MCL-257-203A.pdf). Lower-case 'mcl-' prefix also served (mcl-26-1.pdf, mcl-chap1.pdf). The www. host serves the same files. Whole act: MCL-ACT-{act}-OF-{year}.pdf. Repealed ranges are served under the first section of the range (600.5040-600.5065 under MCL-600-5040.pdf). Index (chapter → acts with section ranges): https://legislature.mi.gov/Laws/ChapterIndex → GetObject?objectName=mcl-chap{N}.

automation.robots_txt: fetch_doc.py: robots.txt on legislature.mi.gov and www.legislature.mi.gov answered with a bot check — host refused
automation.notes: WebFetch reads the PDFs when the URL came from a search result (MCL-257-201, MCL-600-5040, MCL-750-567, MCL-750-46 all OK), but built URLs (mcl-600-5805.pdf) waited on a permission prompt and timed out: each built URL needs user approval. Site 'Automated Data Collection Policy' (legislature.mi.gov/Home/AutomatedDataCollectionPolicy) permits automated access at max 1 request/second; nevertheless fetch_doc.py is refused at robots.txt, so do not use the shell. Mirror hostnames seen in search results (zeus-milenia., hercules-milenia., capitol., ombudsman., renderpdf.legislature.mi.gov) are not used.

access.pattern_rules: File name is the rule set's range ('R 408.10001 to R 408.10098.pdf'), not derivable from a single rule number. Append &ReturnHTML=True for HTML. automation.notes: Department names as in the form: 'Labor and Economic Opportunity', 'Environment, Great Lakes and Energy', 'Licensing and Regulatory Affairs', etc. MIOSHA listing is ~152K chars.
